blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Test-time scaling (TTS) improves generative models by allocating additional inference-time computation to sampling, search, and verification. Existing image generation approaches, however, typically rank completed images or image-centric intermediate states. We study TTS for parallel multimodal discrete diffusion language models, in which reasoning tokens and image tokens are decoded jointly within a single generation trajectory. We first diagnose a limitation of conventional final-image selection: on GenEval, a CLIP-style image-prompt score is weakly aligned with within-prompt compositional correctness, leaving substantial headroom between verifier selection and oracle selection. We then propose PATTS, a novel parallel-aware TTS framework that searches over intermediate thought-image states using cross-modal verifier signals. PATTS uses a state-dependent reliability weight, derived from model-internal trajectory diagnostics, to modulate the influence of external semantic verification during generation. In the fixed N=32 evaluation on MMaDA-Parallel, the PATTS reaches a GenEval score of 0.844, compared with 0.628 without TTS, 0.787 for Best-of-N, and 0.810 for FKD. These results show that reliability-aware trajectory verification can improve test-time selection for parallel thought-image co-generation under the evaluated search budget. Our code release is at https://github.com/Ringo-Star/PATTS.git

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Test-time scaling (TTS) improves generation by spending extra computation at inference time rather than retraining the model. In visual generation, this extra budget is usually allocated along image-centric axes: more denoising steps, more random trajectories, or best-of- N N selection with a final-image VLM verifier model [ 17 , 9 , 25 ] . These strategies are effective when a completed image is the natural unit of search. However, they are less complete for multimodal diffusion language models, where generation can expose a richer trajectory than a sequence of final images.
blocks.zh: 测试时间缩放(TTS)通过在推断时间花费额外的计算来改进生成,而不是再培训模型. 在视觉生成中,这种额外的预算通常按照以图像为核心的轴来分配:更去名阶,更随机的轨迹,或使用最终成像VLM验证模型的N最佳选择[17,9,25]. 当完成的图像是自然的搜索单位时,这些策略是有效的. 然而,对于多模式传播语言模型来说,它们并不那么完整,在这种语言模型中,一代人能够暴露出比一系列最终图像更丰富的轨迹.

blocks.en:
Conventional CLIP-style prompt-image scores primarily capture global semantic alignment and may fail to distinguish images that satisfy fine-grained compositional constraints from those that do not. On GenEval, CLIP-based search improves the average correctness of a 16-trajectories TTS only from 86.51% to 87.34%, while an oracle selector reaches 96.75%. This substantial gap motivates exploring additional information beyond final-image similarity for guiding test-time search.
Parallel thinking-generation models make this limitation explicit. In MMaDA-Parallel [ 26 ] , textual reasoning tokens and image tokens are decoded jointly inside a single masked diffusion process, as shown in Figure PATTS: Parallel-Aware Test-Time Scaling for Thought-Image Generation in Multimodal Discrete Diffusion LLMs . This creates a new inference-time scaling opportunity: instead of verifying the final image, a search method can inspect partially decoded thought-image states and select trajectories using their evolving cross-modal information.
blocks.zh:
常规CLIP风格的即时图像分数主要捕捉出全球语义对齐,可能无法将满足精细成份限制的图像与不满足的图像区分开来. 在GenEval上,基于CLIP的搜索只改进了16个出射TTS的平均正确性从86.51%到87.34%,而甲骨文选择器则达到96.75%. 这一巨大差距促使人们探索超越最终图像相似性的额外信息,以指导测试时间搜索。
平行的思维生成模式明确了这一限制。 在MMADA-Parallel [26]中,文字推理活符和图像活符在一个被遮盖的单一传播过程中共同解码,如图PATTS所示: 在多式散射LLMs中为思维-图像生成进行平行的智能测试-时间缩放。 这创造了一个新的推论时间缩放机会:一个搜索方法不是验证最终图像,而是可以检查部分解码的思维-图像状态并使用其正在演变的跨模式信息选择轨迹.

blocks.en: However, exploiting these intermediate states introduces a new challenge: their semantic content may be unreliable before denoising is sufficiently advanced. Early previews can be unstable, while late previews are easier to verify but leave less room to redirect generation. Moreover, the reasoning and image states may become misaligned, producing plausible reasoning traces alongside images that violate spatial relations or fine-grained attributes. The central question is therefore not simply how to sample more candidates, but when an intermediate thought-image state is reliable enough to guide search.
blocks.zh: 然而,利用这些中间状态带来了新的挑战:它们的语义内容可能不可靠,然后才能充分去名化。 早期预览可能不稳定,而后期预览则更容易被验证,但留下较少的回转生成空间. 此外,推理和图像状态可能变得错位,产生与违反空间关系或精细属性的图像相伴而来的合理推理痕迹。 因此,中心问题不仅仅是如何对更多候选人进行抽样,而是当中间思想-图像状态足够可靠,足以指导搜索时.

blocks.en: We study this problem in parallel multimodal discrete diffusion LLMs and propose PATTS , a parallel-aware test-time scaling framework for thought-image generation. PATTS maintains multiple denoising trajectories and forms predicted clean thought-image previews at selected cutpoints. Rather than applying external semantic verification uniformly across denoising steps, PATTS estimates the reliability of each intermediate state using lightweight model-internal diagnostics, include token confidence, uncertainty, preview stability, and cross-modal agreement. A state-dependent trust gate then adaptively combines internal diagnostics with external VLM verification, reducing reliance on unstable intermediate previews while emphasizing external verification only in late stage of generation process.
blocks.zh: 我们用平行的多模式离散扩散有限责任公司来研究这个问题,并提议将PATTS作为思维图像生成的平行认识试验时间缩放框架。 PATTS在所选择的切口上维持多条去诺化轨迹并形成预测的清洁思维-图像预览. PATTS使用轻量级模型-内部诊断法,对每个中间状态的可靠性进行估计,而不是在解密步骤之间统一应用外部语义核查,其中包括象征性的自信、不确定性、预览稳定性和跨模式协议。 然后一个依赖状态的信任门适应性地将内部诊断与外部VLM验证相结合,减少对不稳定中间预览的依赖,同时强调外部验证只在生成过程后期进行.

blocks.en:
Although intuitive straightforward, our experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of reliability-aware trajectory search. On MMaDA-Parallel, enabling parallel reasoning without verification reduces GenEval score from 0.65 to 0.62, with the largest degradation on position and attribute. Under a fixed N = 32 N=32 evaluation, PATTS achieves 0.844, compared with 0.628 without TTS, 0.787 for Best-of-N, and 0.810 for FKD [ 32 ] .
The fixed-setting component breakdown further shows that trajectory-level search, reward routing, and state-dependent trust estimation contribute progressively to the final result, avoiding comparisons across different budgets or configurations.
blocks.zh:
虽然直觉直截了当,但我们的实验证明了可靠性意识轨迹搜索的有效性. 在MMADA-Parallel上,允许在没有验证的情况下并行推理,将GenEval得分从0.65降至0.62,在位置和属性上降解得分最大. 在固定的N=32 N=32评价下,PATTS的成绩为0.844分,而没有TTS的成绩为0.628分,最佳N的成绩为0.787分,FKD的成绩为0.810分 [32].
固定设定部分的分解进一步表明,轨迹级搜索、奖励路径和依赖国家的信任估计逐步有助于最终结果,避免在不同预算或配置之间进行比较。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: 1. We identify empirical limitations of conventional final-image selection TTS for parallel thought-image generation, including weak alignment between CLIP final-image scores and compositional correctness, and image semantic degradation under unverified parallel thinking. 2. We propose PATTS, a trajectory-level, reliability-based search framework that uses model-internal reliability diagnostics to weight external VLM verification of partially decoded thought-image states. 3. We demonstrate improved compositional generation quality and inference efficiency over comprehensive text-to-image generation benchmarks and TTS baselines, and ablate the individual contributions of reward routing and state-dependent trust estimation.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是: 1. 我们确定传统最终图像选择TTS在并行思维图像生成方面的经验限制,包括CLIP最终图像分数与组成正确性之间的微弱对接,以及在未经验证的平行思维下图像语义退化。 2. 我们建议利用模型-内部可靠性诊断法对部分解码思维状态的VLM外部核查进行加权。 3. 我们显示,相对于综合文本到图像生成基准和TTS基线而言,构成生成质量和推论效率有所提高,并降低了奖励路线和依赖国家的信任估计的个人贡献。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Test-time scaling allocates additional inference compute to improve a frozen generator through sampling, search, or verification. In language models, this idea appears as increased reasoning or search budget [ 24 , 18 ] ; In diffusion image generation, recent methods allocate compute to noise search, evolutionary search, path pruning, or verifier-guided candidate selection [ 12 , 17 , 9 , 25 , 31 ] . These approaches largely treat the image trajectory as the object of search and score either final samples or visual denoising states. We instead study a different search object: the joint thought-image trajectory exposed by parallel multimodal diffusion LLMs.
blocks.zh: 测试时间缩放会分配额外的推论计算,通过采样,搜索或核查来改进被冻结的生成器. 在语言模型中,这种想法似乎是增加推理或搜索预算[24、18]; 在扩散图像生成中,最近的方法将计算分配到噪声搜索,进化搜索,路径穿行,或由核查者指导的候选人选择[12,17,9,25,31]. 这些方法基本上将图像轨迹作为搜索对象,并获得最终样品或视觉去诺状态的分数。 相反,我们研究了一个不同的搜索对象:并行的多模式传播LLMs暴露出的联合思维-图像轨迹。

blocks.en:
Thinking-aware image generation asks whether explicit reasoning can improve synthesis and editing. Several recent systems condition generation on a reasoning trace or follow a sequential think-then-generate paradigm [ 8 , 6 , 1 ] . In such pipelines, an error in the thought can propagate into the image, and the image state cannot usually correct the reasoning state once the thought is fixed [ 30 ] .
Parallel multimodal diffusion models change this interface: MMaDA-Parallel [ 26 ] decodes reasoning and image tokens jointly, while unified discrete diffusion generators such as Lumina-DiMOO and Muddit [ 29 , 23 ] show how masked-token diffusion can support multimodal generation. PATTS uses this parallelism as the testbed for trajectory-level test-time scaling rather than treating the model architecture itself as the contribution.
blocks.zh:
思考-意识成像生成问明推理是否能改进合成和编辑. 最近的几个系统以推理追踪作为生成条件,或遵循一个相继的思维再生成范式[8,6,1]. 在这样的管道中,思想错误可以传播到图像中,而一旦思想被固定[30],图像状态通常不能纠正推理状态.
平行多模式扩散模型会改变这个界面:MMADA-Parallel [26] 解码推理和图像符号联合,而Lumina-DimoO和Muddit等统一的离散扩散生成器[29,23] 显示被掩体扩散如何能支持多模式生成. PATTS将这种平行主义作为轨迹水平测试时间缩放的试验台,而不是将模型架构本身作为贡献来对待.

blocks.en:
Recent multimodal TTS work extends language-model-style inference scaling to unified multimodal models. However, general vision-language models offer limited verifier reward quality on complex and compositional image generation benchmarks [ 13 ] .
CLIP-style prompt-image scores [ 21 ] are convenient for best-of- N N selection, but compositional benchmarks often require object-level counting, attributes, relations, and binding rather than global image–text similarity.
Recent multimodal TTS and refinement systems use stronger VLMs or unified models to generate, verify, and revise outputs through multi-round reasoning [ 4 , 33 , 28 , 14 ] . These methods mainly verify completed outputs or sequential refinement states.
Our focus is on when partially decoded thought-image states in a parallel diffusion trajectory are reliable enough to verify.
We find that final prompt-image verifiers can select visually plausible samples while still failing to rank compositional correctness reliably. This motivates treating verification as a trajectory-dependent reliability problem rather than a fixed final-output scoring step.
blocks.zh:
近期的多模式TTS工作将语言-模型风格的推论扩展至统一的多模式模型. 然而,一般的视觉语言模型在复杂和组成成像生成基准上提供有限的验证人奖励质量[13].
CLIP风格的即时图像分数[21]对于N最佳选取来说是方便的,但组成基准往往需要对象级计数,属性,关系,以及约束而非全局图像-文本的相似性.
近期的多式TTS和精细系统使用更强的VLM或统一模型来通过多轮推理生成,验证并修改输出[4,33,28,14]. 这些方法主要核查已完成的产出或相继的完善状态。
我们的重点是,当部分解码的思维图像处于平行传播轨迹时,其可靠性足以核实。
我们发现,最后的即时图像验证员可以选择可视的可视性样本,同时仍然不能可靠地对组成正确性进行排名。 这促使将核查视为依赖轨道的可靠性问题,而不是固定的最终产出评分步骤。

blocks.en:
Intermediate verification is difficult because intermediate states are not always semantically meaningful. In continuous diffusion models, a verifier often sees a noisy latent or a predicted clean image, so prior work use estimate of final output from current state [ 17 , 9 , 25 ] or train a noise-aware verifier model [ 31 ] .
Discrete diffusion multimodal LLMs [ 2 ] provide a different interface: an intermediate state is partially unmasked, and a clean preview can expose both predicted reasoning tokens and predicted image tokens [ 19 , 29 , 23 ] . This makes prompt-thought, prompt-image, and thought-image consistency measurable before the final sample, but only when the preview is stable enough.
Existing intermediate-state verifiers do not exploit this structure and remain insufficient for the partially decoded thought–image states that arise in parallel thinking-aware dMLLMs. We address this reliability problem directly through a state-dependent trust gate rather than applying a fixed verifier schedule.
blocks.zh:
中间核查是困难的,因为中间国家并不总是具有整体意义。 在连续扩散模型中,核查者经常看到一个吵闹的潜伏或预测的清洁图像,因此先前的工作用途估计了当前状态的最终输出[17,9,25],或者训练出一个意识到噪音的核查者模型[31].
分散扩散多模式LLMS[2]提供了一个不同的界面:中间状态部分被解析出来,一个干净的预览可以同时暴露出预测的推理符和预测的图像符[19,29,23]. 这使得"即时思考","即时映像","即时思考"的相容性在最终样本之前是可以测量的,但只有在预览足够稳定时才能进行.
现有的中间状态核查员没有利用这种结构,对于部分被解码的思想-在平行思维-意识dMLLM中产生的图像状态来说仍然不足. 我们直接通过依赖国家的信任门而不是采用固定的核查时间表来解决这一可靠性问题。

blocks.en:
We use the GenEval compositional generation benchmark [ 7 ] with 553 prompts spanning six categories: single object, two object, counting, colors, position, and color attributes. Generated images are scored with the standard Mask2Former object detector [ 5 ] , and we report the GenEval overall score as the unweighted mean of the six category accuracies.
We additionally evaluate cross-benchmark robustness on T2I-CompBench [ 13 ] and DPG-Bench [ 11 ] using each benchmark’s official evaluator and overall score.
Unless otherwise annotated, evaluations use 4 repeated runs to decrease evaluation instability.

blocks.en: Table 1 compares PATTS with representative test-time scaling baselines under MMaDA-Parallel. PATTS achieves the best overall GenEval score of 0.844, improving over No TTS (0.628), HTS (0.711), Best-of- N N /LTS (0.787), and FKD (0.810). blocks.en: 4.4 When is a state reliable enough to verify?
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 何时国家可靠,足以核实?

blocks.en:
PATTS applies the external verifier to the predicted clean state z ^ 0 ( t ) \hat{z}_{0}^{(t)} only when the trajectory is estimated to be reliable, so whether such a moment is identifiable from cheap online features is an empirical question.
In Figure 5 , under hierarchical beam search, at each cut point we take the top-scoring particle per prompt and Spearman-correlate each selection signal against whether that prompt’s final image is GenEval-correct. For external VLM reward, the correlations are relatively weak and unstable at early cut points and become stronger and more consistent as denoising proceeds. This is the regime the trust gate is designed to exploit: it down-weights external verification while the predicted clean state is uninformative and increases its weight once the state stabilizes. The same observation bounds what the gate can achieve on attribute prompts, the category where the late-denoising signal remains weakest (failure mode 1) and where, correspondingly, trust-gated verification yields the smallest gain in Sec. 4.2 .

Table 4 isolates the PATTS components on the GenEval at N = 16 N=16 on counting subset, where the internal trajectory reward is least predictive of final correctness and therefore provides a challenging test for the method. We report mixed outcomes:
For reward routing, the continuous reliability mixture improves over external-only verification from 0.62 to 0.66, while internal-only routing falls below no-search; on this subset the internal reward is thus useful as a gate input but not as a standalone selector.
For trust estimation, the full state-dependent feature set slightly outperforms a timestep-only schedule (rank accuracy 0.19 0.19 vs. 0.17 0.17 ), while partial feature subsets remain below the timestep baseline.
The clearest gain appears in verifier efficiency: the adaptive controller raises score per verifier call from 0.021 0.021 to 0.036 0.036 , substantially reducing verifier cost relative to a fixed beam.
Therefore, on this subset, the main measurable benefit of the reliability-calibrated design is improved verifier-call efficiency rather than a further gain in absolute accuracy, consistent with the weak intermediate-reward correlation reported in Sec. 4.4 .

The result therefore suggests that trajectory diagnostics provide a modest improvement over timestep-only reliability estimation, while the larger end-to-end gain accumulates across trajectory search, reward routing, and trust-aware selection.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We studied test-time scaling for parallel multimodal diffusion LLMs, where reasoning tokens and image tokens co-evolve within a single generation trajectory. Our analysis shows that final-image selection alone can be limited in this setting: CLIP-style prompt-image scores may favour visually plausible samples without reliably ranking compositional correctness. We introduce PATTS, a state-dependent reliability-weighted trajectory search method that uses model-internal diagnostics to determine when predicted clean thought-image states should receive stronger external VLM verification. On GenEval, the complete PATTS configuration improves over final-output reranking in the fixed- N = 32 N=32 design sweep. The ablations further show that reliable intermediate verification remains the central limitation: internal trajectory signals are not semantic verifiers by themselves, and future progress depends on stronger verifier alignment and more reliable intermediate-state scoring.
blocks.zh: 我们研究了平行多模式扩散LLMs的试验时间缩放,其中推理符号和图像符号在一个一代人的轨迹中共同演化. 我们的分析表明,在此情况下,仅最后形象选择可以受到限制: CLIP风格的即时图像分数可能有利于视觉上可信的样本,而不可靠地排列成份的正确性. 我们引入了PATTS,一种依赖国家的可靠性加权轨迹搜索方法,它使用模型-内部诊断来确定预计的清洁思维-图像状态何时应接受更强大的外部VLM验证. 在GenEval上,完整的PATTS配置比固定-N = 32 N = 32设计扫描中的最终输出重排有所改进. 浮出水面进一步表明,可靠的中间核查仍然是中心限制:内部轨迹信号本身并不是语义核查器,今后的进展取决于更强的核查器对接和更可靠的中间状态评分.

blocks.en: Table 3 in the main paper isolates the effect of enabling the reasoning trace under the active MMaDA-Parallel evaluation used in the main paper. Standard T2I decoding without the reasoning trace reaches a GenEval overall score of 0.65 0.65 , while thinking-aware decoding without verification reaches 0.62 0.62 ( − 0.03 -0.03 ). The change is category-dependent: single-object, two-object, and counting accuracy are preserved or slightly improved ( 0.95 → 0.97 0.95\to 0.97 , 0.71 → 0.72 0.71\to 0.72 , and 0.43 → 0.48 0.43\to 0.48 ), color is unchanged, but position accuracy drops sharply ( 0.57 → 0.31 0.57\to 0.31 ) and attribute accuracy decreases slightly ( 0.56 → 0.54 0.56\to 0.54 ). This supports the main-paper interpretation that unverified parallel thinking does not simply reduce image quality globally; rather, it can introduce semantic drift in spatial grounding and fine-grained binding when the text and image states are not kept aligned.
